description: Ten UK micro-businesses spanning the range the pipeline has to handle: different industries, budgets from £0 to £900, and brand voices that should visibly change the copy. Deliberately includes thin inputs and awkward cases — an even spread of easy briefs would tell you nothing.

businesses.note: The blueprint's worked example. Rich input, clear differentiator.

business.name: Hearth & Crumb Bakery
business.offer_description: Artisan sourdough, celebration cakes, and a weekly bread subscription baked in small batches.

campaign.goal: Book 25 wedding cake consultations before peak season

businesses.note: £0 budget. The plan must be organic-only and say so rather than quietly assuming ad spend.

business.name: Studio Forma
business.offer_description: Small-group reformer pilates, maximum six people per class.

campaign.goal: Fill the six Saturday morning classes every week

businesses.note: Deliberately sparse. Should populate `constraints` with what is unknown instead of inventing detail.
Long sales cycle, LinkedIn-shaped. Should not default to Instagram Reels.

business.name: Ledgerloop
business.offer_description: Reconciliation software for small accountancy practices. Connects to Xero and flags mismatches before month end.

campaign.goal: Get 15 practices onto a free trial before the January rush

businesses.note: Health-adjacent. Must not promise outcomes; watch for regulated claims.

business.name: Quiet Hours Sleep Coaching
business.offer_description: Six-week one-to-one sleep coaching for parents of babies and toddlers. Not medical advice.

businesses.note: Product-led, visual. Product and lifestyle shots should feature.

business.name: Ridgeway Candle Co.
business.offer_description: Hand-poured soy candles in refillable ceramic vessels. Refills posted for half the price of a new candle.

campaign.goal: Grow repeat refill orders from 12% to 25% of revenue

businesses.note: Referral-driven, trust-heavy, low volume. Should not recommend high-cadence posting.

business.name: Alder & Finch Family Law
business.offer_description: Fixed-fee divorce and separation support, with a mediation-first approach.

campaign.goal: Get 8 initial consultations a month from outside our referral network

businesses.note: The only brief where meme-overlay should be eligible.

business.name: Bad Dog Coffee
business.offer_description: A dog-friendly speciality coffee shop with a rotating single-origin filter and free biscuits for dogs.

campaign.goal: Get 200 people onto the loyalty app before winter

businesses.note: One-person business selling their own taste. Founder-to-camera should feature.

business.name: Marek Sokol Photography
business.offer_description: Documentary-style wedding photography. No posed group shots, full gallery within two weeks.

businesses.note: 14 days. The calendar must not exceed the timeframe.

business.name: The Old Pier Fish Bar
business.offer_description: Fish and chips fried in beef dripping, using day-boat catch from the harbour.

campaign.goal: Pull in the bank holiday weekend crowd
